mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_user u JOIN t_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN t_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN t_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.status = 1 AND p.permission_code = #{permissionCode}

SELECT u.id FROM t_user u JOIN t_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN t_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN t_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE p.permission_code = #{permissionCode} AND u.status = 1 GROUP BY u.id
